title: Section Incharge -Sand Plant
description:
**SECTION IN\-CHARGE – SAND PLANT**
 Foundry Manufacturing Industry
   

  

**Position:** 
 Section In\-Charge – Sand Plant
   

  

**Department:** 
 Sand Plant Maintenance
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5–10 Years in Foundry Sand Plant / Moulding Operations
   

  

**Qualification:** 
 Diploma / BE / B.Tech – Mechanical / Production / Foundry Technology
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* 
+ Overall responsibility for sand plant operations, production and quality.
+ Control and maintain green sand properties such as moisture, compactability, permeability, GCS and other defined parameters.
+ Ensure proper sand preparation, mixing, reclamation and distribution as per process standards.
+ Monitor sand plant equipment, mixers, conveyors, screens, coolers and reclamation systems.
+ Ensure availability and proper control of bentonite, coal dust, additives and other consumables.
+ Coordinate with Moulding, Melting, Quality and Maintenance departments for smooth production.
+ Analyze and control casting defects related to moulding sand such as blowholes, scabs, sand inclusion, veining and poor mould strength.
+ Monitor sand consumption, rejection, productivity and process losses and initiate improvement actions.
+ Ensure implementation of 5S, safety, SOPs, Kaizen and continuous improvement activities.
+ Maintain daily production, quality and process parameter records.
+ Lead and develop operators and technicians working in the sand plant.


**Desired Skills**
* 
+ Strong knowledge of Green Sand Process and Sand Plant Operations.
+ Good understanding of foundry defects and their relationship with sand properties.
+ Knowledge of sand testing and process control.
+ Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.
+ Ability to lead manpower and coordinate with cross\-functional teams.
+ Knowledge of 5S, Kaizen, TPM and safety practices will be an advantage.


**Additional Benefits:** 
 PF / Mediclaim / Leave Payment
   

  

**Facility:** 
 Accommodation provided free of cost
   

  

 subsidiary Canteen /Transport facility
   

  

**Working Shift will be 8 hrs**

title: Plant Manager
description:
Job Accountabilities
   

  

 Critically monitoring of process parameters \& efficiencies through regular Audits, highlighting the deviations and recommending the corrective actions required for achieving the Plant performance levels.
   

  

 Achievement of specific consumptions with regard to raw material, chemicals \& utilities as per the budget norms.
   

  

 Troubleshooting of various problems through proper analysis. Analysis of failures and recommending measures for preventing recurrence. Ensuring compliance of recommendations.
   

  

 To coordinate the activities of the Site Apex Committee and ensure that all decisions taken by this Committee are implemented.
   

  

 Strong process knowledge, production Planning Skills and technical competence \& to facilitate operating plants to achieve budgeted quality targets.
   

  

 Constant process vigilance to detect deviation in process parameters in time.
   

  

 Reduction in Conversion Cost on sustainable basis.
   

  

 Execution of activities as per the safety norms (ZT\-LPR rules) with zero accident level.
   

  

 Coordinate erection, commissioning and execution of New Projects.
   

  

 Effective inter\-action with RTG/CTS on improvements in technology.
   

  

 Lead the commissioning, pre\-commissioning, and startup activities for new plants, ensuring all systems and processes are functioning optimally before full\-scale operations.
   

  

 Manage and oversee multidisciplinary teams involved in the plant setup.
   

  

 Conduct performance guarantee trials of package units and the overall plant to meet the expected performance and efficiency targets.
   

  

 Drive the implementation of digitalization technologies.
   

  

**Skills Required (Knowledge And Skills)**
 Communication Skills
   

  

 Discrete and Ethical
   

  

 Conflict Management \& Problem Solving
   

  

 Time Management Business acumen
   

  

 Strong team building, people engagement process and decision\-making
   

  

 Familiarity with industry standard equipment and technical expertise
   

  

 Possess understanding of people and capability to train and assign them appropriate tasks and optimize people resource for improving productivity targets.
   

  

**Key Attributes (Experience And Qualifications)**
 Degree / Post Graduation in Chemical Engineering or equivalent
   

  

 15\+ years Experience with specific experience in PVC and VCM plant operations being mandatory

title: Lead Construction Manager
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
 The Lead Construction Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing all construction activities related to civil, structural, and mechanical disciplines during project execution. The role ensures safe, high\-quality, and efficient delivery of construction works while achieving project objectives related to scope, schedule, cost, quality, and compliance. The position serves as the primary site leader coordinating contractors, engineers, suppliers, and stakeholders throughout construction, commissioning support, and project handover.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Construction Leadership \& Site Management**
* Lead all site construction activities across civil, structural, mechanical, piping, and utility scopes.
* Establish execution strategies, construction methodologies, and resource plans.
* Direct field teams and contractors to ensure efficient execution of work packages.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for site construction performance.


**Civil \& Structural Construction Management**
* Oversee earthworks, excavation, foundations, piling, concrete structures, buildings, roads, drainage systems, and underground utilities.
* Ensure construction activities are executed according to approved designs, specifications, and engineering standards.
* Coordinate interfaces between civil works and mechanical installation activities.


**Mechanical Construction Management**
* Lead installation of process equipment, utilities, piping systems, HVAC, tanks, pumps, and supporting infrastructure.
* Ensure proper sequencing of equipment erection, alignment, testing, and mechanical completion.
* Support commissioning and start\-up readiness activities.
* Resolve field technical issues in collaboration with engineering teams and vendors.


**Contractor \& Stakeholder Management**
* Manage EPC/EPCM contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and suppliers.
* Conduct contractor performance reviews and monitor productivity.
* Lead construction progress meetings and coordinate stakeholder alignment.
* Ensure effective communication between project management, engineering, operations, maintenance, and safety teams.


**Safety, Health \& Environmental Management**
* Promote and enforce a zero\-accident safety culture.
* Ensure compliance with site safety requirements, permit\-to\-work systems, and regulatory standards.
* Lead risk assessments, toolbox talks, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
* Drive EHS compliance throughout project execution.


**Schedule, Cost \& Risk Management**
* Monitor construction schedules, milestones, and productivity metrics.
* Identify critical path risks and develop recovery plans when required.
* Control construction budgets and manage variations, claims, and change orders.
* Support forecasting and reporting to project leadership.


**Quality Assurance \& Compliance**
* Ensure implementation of QA/QC processes, inspection plans, and testing requirements.
* Review and approve method statements, inspection records, and construction documentation.
* Drive first\-time\-right execution and minimize rework.
* Ensure statutory, regulatory, and company compliance requirements are met.


**Commissioning \& Handover**
* Coordinate mechanical completion and turnover processes.
* Ensure punch\-list closure and construction readiness for commissioning.
* Support operational acceptance, training, and project handover.
* Ensure as\-built documentation and final project records are complete.


**In this role you’ll make an impact by:**
* Delivering complex construction projects safely, on time, and within budget while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance.
* Leading multidisciplinary civil and mechanical construction teams to achieve key project milestones and operational readiness.
* Driving construction excellence through proactive planning, contractor management, and risk mitigation.
* Ensuring seamless integration between civil infrastructure, mechanical systems, utilities, equipment installation, and commissioning activities.
* Creating a strong safety culture that prioritizes people, environmental sustainability, and operational integrity.
* Enabling successful project handover through disciplined execution, quality assurance, and stakeholder collaboration.


**To succeed:**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.
* Professional certification in Project Management, Construction Management, or equivalent preferred.


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of experience in industrial construction, manufacturing projects, CAPEX projects, chemical/manufacturing industries.
* Proven experience managing both civil and mechanical construction activities.
* Experience in greenfield and brownfield project execution.
* Strong experience in contractor construction management and commissioning support.


**Key Competencies**
* Construction Execution Leadership
* Civil \& Structural Engineering Knowledge
* Mechanical Installation Management
* Contractor Management
* Project Planning \& Scheduling
* Cost and Risk Management
* EHS Leadership
* Quality Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Conflict Resolution and Decision Making

title: Data Center Operations Supervisor - 3rd Shift
description:

title: Advanced Specialist / Senior Specialist - QMS
description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as
 **ROLE** 
 .
   

  

**About The Role**
 Autoliv is seeking an experienced
 **Advanced Specialist / Senior Specialist** 
**\- (QMS)** 
 to drive and strengthen Quality Management System implementation across manufacturing operations in India. This role will play a critical part in ensuring compliance with industry standards, customer requirements, and Autoliv quality policies while fostering a strong quality culture and continuous improvement mindset across the organization.
   

  

 As the Division Management Representative (MR) for QMS, you will lead internal audits, certification activities, system improvements, and quality excellence initiatives across multiple sites.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Quality Management System Leadership
   

  

* Ensure effective implementation and maintenance of the Quality Management System across all operating locations.
* Promote a process\-driven and quality\-focused culture throughout the organization.
* Drive continuous improvement of QMS effectiveness and robustness.
* Act as the primary QMS liaison between local operations and Global/Head Office teams.


 Audit \& Compliance Management
   

  

* Plan, conduct, and follow up on internal Quality Management System audits.
* Lead and support problem\-solving activities related to audit findings.
* Manage certification and surveillance audits with external certification bodies.
* Coordinate third\-party audits and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, customer\-specific requirements, and Autoliv standards.


 Process Excellence \& Quality Tools
   

  

* Drive implementation of quality methodologies and tools including:
+ APQP
+ PPAP
+ FMEA
+ SPC
+ MSA
+ 8D Problem Solving

* Enable process standardization and operational excellence across the division.
* Lead quality system improvement projects and best\-practice sharing initiatives.


 Management Systems \& Reporting
   

  

* Coordinate Management Review activities and action plans.
* Develop, maintain, and update management system documentation and manuals.
* Manage common quality systems and databases for audits, corrective actions, procedures, and reporting.
* Prepare quality performance reports and management review inputs aligned with global reporting standards.


 Training \& Capability Building
   

  

* Provide training and support on Quality Management Systems and standards.
* Develop a strong pool of internal auditors.
* Drive quality awareness and competency development across teams.


**Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.


**Experience**
* 10 to 15 years of experience in the automotive industry.
* Proven experience managing Quality Management Systems in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience independently leading audits, quality initiatives, and cross\-functional improvement programs.
* Strong exposure to assembly, manufacturing, logistics, warehouse, or industrial operations.


 Required Certifications
   

  

* Lead Auditor Certification \- ISO 9001:2015\.

**Preferred Certifications**
* Six Sigma or Shainin Certification.
* VDA 6\.3 Process Auditor Certification.

 Technical Expertise

title: Ecommerce Business Manager
description:
Role Overview
 
  





 We are looking for a
 **E\-Commerce Business manager** 
 to own the end\-to\-end e\-commerce business across the company’s
 **own digital platform and third\-party marketplaces** 
 .
 



 The role will combine
 **e\-commerce operations, P\&L ownership, business growth, marketplace management, inventory and supply chain coordination, customer experience, and cross\-functional leadership** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should understand the complete e\-commerce ecosystem — from product listing and inventory availability to order processing, fulfilment, customer experience, marketplace performance, profitability, and business growth.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Experience managing ecommerce platforms (e.g., marketplaces or branded online stores), including catalog management and order processing.
* Skills in sales analysis, data\-driven decision\-making, and reporting on ecommerce performance metrics.
* Ability to coordinate with marketing teams on digital campaigns, promotions, and customer acquisition strategies.
* Strong organizational and operational skills for inventory tracking, vendor coordination, and logistics oversight.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and team collaboration abilities.
* Proven experience in ecommerce, retail, or business management; prior leadership or P\&L responsibility is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field; advanced certifications in ecommerce or digital business are a plus.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced environment, with a proactive approach to problem\-solving and continuous improvement.
